summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BidCa.ca full-featured auction platform. Backend API tests achieved 96.2% success rate (25/26 tests passed). Frontend testing revealed critical login functionality issue preventing full authentication flow testing. Core features like homepage, search, registration, and BC postal code validation working correctly.

minor_bugs.issue: Brute force protection test failing - returns 401 instead of 429 after 5 failed attempts
minor_bugs.impact: Security feature may not be working as expected

critical_bugs.issue: Login form submission not triggering API call - no network request made when clicking Sign In button
critical_bugs.impact: Prevents user authentication and access to protected features

integration_issues.issue: Unable to test admin panel, create listing, auction bidding, watchlist due to login issue

passed_tests: Homepage loads with all sections (hero, search, categories, ending soon, featured auctions)
Browse Auctions page with filters and sorting
Registration page with BC postal code validation
User registration successful with valid BC data (V6B1A1)
Authentication protection (redirects to login for protected pages)
Backend API health checks (96.2% success rate)
